tools.name: slam_health
tools.description: Introspect the SLAM MCP server: protocol version, server version, SQLite version, database path, row counts per table, table schema (column names per table), last sync timestamp, and store metadata. Call ONCE per session at the start — use table_schema to know exact column names before writing any query, avoiding runtime column errors.

include_row_counts.description: Include per-table row counts. Defaults to true.

include_schema.description: Include column lists for every table. Defaults to true.

tools.name: slam_meta_status
tools.description: [Requires slam_health] Returns sync metadata (last sync time, minutes since sync) and row counts for every entity table in the SLAM database.

tools.name: slam_meta_store
tools.description: [Requires slam_health] Returns store information from the SLAM metadata table: shop domain, currency, timezone, and other store-level settings.

tools.name: slam_meta_schema
tools.description: [Requires slam_health] Returns the full database schema (tables + columns), logical relationships, TEMP view documentation with semantic descriptions and column type notes, and copy-paste SQL patterns for common cross-table queries. Call this before writing slam_run_query to understand the data model.

tools.name: slam_metafields_query
tools.description: [Requires slam_health] Browse and filter metafields (custom fields) across products, variants, customers, orders, and collections. Filter by owner type, namespace, key, a specific entity ID, or a substring of the value. Returns owner label (product title, customer email, or variant title) alongside each metafield.

owner_type.description: Filter to metafields owned by this entity type (PRODUCT, PRODUCTVARIANT, CUSTOMER, ORDER, COLLECTION)

owner_id.description: Return all metafields for this specific entity (Shopify GID)

value_contains.description: LIKE filter on value — returns metafields whose value contains this string

tools.name: slam_products_list
tools.description: [Requires slam_health] Returns a paginated list of products with variant counts. Supports filtering by status, vendor, and product_type. Use the data_quality parameter to filter to products with content gaps (e.g. 'no_description' returns only products with empty body_html).

data_quality.description: Filter to products with a specific data quality gap: 'no_description' (empty body_html), 'no_tags' (no rows in product_tags)

tools.name: slam_products_get
tools.description: [Requires slam_health] Returns a single product by ID, including all its variants, collection memberships, and metafields.

tools.name: slam_products_search
tools.description: [Requires slam_health] Searches products by title, vendor, product_type, or tags using LIKE matching. Returns paginated results with variant counts.

query.description: Search term (matched with LIKE against title, vendor, product_type, tags)

tools.name: slam_products_count
tools.description: [Requires slam_health] Returns the total count of products, optionally filtered by status, vendor, or product_type.

tools.name: slam_product_images
tools.description: [Requires slam_health] Returns product images from the product_media table. Supports filtering by product_id.

product_id.description: Filter to images for a specific product

tools.name: slam_variants_list
tools.description: [Requires slam_health] Returns a paginated list of variants. Optionally filter by product_id to see variants for a specific product.

data_quality.description: Filter to variants with a specific data quality gap: 'no_sku' (empty or null SKU), 'no_barcode' (empty or null barcode)

tools.name: slam_variants_get
tools.description: [Requires slam_health] Returns a single variant by ID, including parent product information, inventory items, and inventory levels.

tools.name: slam_variants_search
tools.description: [Requires slam_health] Look up variants by exact SKU or barcode. Returns variant details plus parent product info. Provide sku, barcode, or both.

tools.name: slam_variant_options
tools.description: [Requires slam_health] Returns product option names and values from the product_options table (option_values stored as JSON).

product_id.description: The product ID to fetch options for

tools.name: slam_inventory_levels
tools.description: [Requires slam_health] Returns inventory levels joined with variant info (SKU, title) and location name. Filterable by product_id, SKU, or location_id.

tools.name: slam_inventory_summary
tools.description: [Requires slam_health] Returns aggregated inventory statistics: total SKUs tracked, total units, units by location, out-of-stock count, and low stock count.

tools.name: slam_inventory_alerts
tools.description: [Requires slam_health] Returns variants at or below a stock threshold — your reorder list. Uses multi-location inventory_levels aggregation via the variant_stock_health view. Sorted by lowest stock first.

threshold.description: Return variants where total_available <= this value (default 5). Use 0 for out-of-stock only.

include_zero_only.description: If true, only return variants with total_available = 0 (overrides threshold)

tools.name: slam_inventory_oversold
tools.description: [Requires slam_health] Returns variants where total available stock is negative — meaning orders have exceeded inventory (overselling). Distinct from out-of-stock (zero stock). Sorted by most negative first.

tools.name: slam_inventory_by_location
tools.description: [Requires slam_health] Returns inventory stock totals aggregated by location (warehouse/store). Shows available, on_hand, reserved, and committed units per location.

location_id.description: Optional: filter to a single location by Shopify GID

tools.name: slam_dead_stock
tools.description: [Requires slam_health] Returns variants that have available inventory but no recorded sales (order_count = 0). Useful for identifying stock to clearance or discontinue. Sorted by highest stock first.

min_available.description: Only return variants with at least this much available stock (default 1)

tools.name: slam_collections_list
tools.description: [Requires slam_health] Returns a paginated list of collections with product counts. Filterable by collection_type ('smart' or 'custom').

collection_type.description: Filter by collection type: 'smart' (has rules) or 'custom' (no rules)

tools.name: slam_collections_get
tools.description: [Requires slam_health] Returns a single collection by ID, including all member products.

tools.name: slam_collections_for_product
tools.description: [Requires slam_health] Returns all collections that contain the specified product.

tools.name: slam_products_for_collection
tools.description: [Requires slam_health] Returns all products in a collection, each enriched with variant count and sales metrics (order_count, units_sold, total_revenue) from the product_sales view. Products with no sales show zeros.

sort_by.description: Column to sort by: title, vendor, total_revenue, or units_sold

tools.name: slam_orders_list
tools.description: [Requires slam_health] Returns a paginated list of orders with customer name and line item count. Filterable by financial_status and fulfillment_status.

tools.name: slam_orders_get
tools.description: [Requires slam_health] Returns a single order by ID, including line items, discount codes, and customer info.

tools.name: slam_orders_search
tools.description: [Requires slam_health] Search orders by customer email or name fragment, date range, or status. Use for support workflows like 'find all orders from jane@example.com' or 'show unfulfilled orders from last week'.

query.description: Search term matched against customer email (LIKE) or order name (LIKE)

date_from.description: ISO date string, inclusive lower bound on created_at

date_to.description: ISO date string, inclusive upper bound on created_at

tools.name: slam_order_line_items_list
tools.description: [Requires slam_health] List individual order line items. Filter by product, variant, or specific order. Useful for cross-order product queries like 'show all orders containing variant X' or 'which orders had this product?'

product_id.description: Filter to line items for this product ID

variant_id.description: Filter to line items for this variant ID

order_id.description: Filter to line items from this order ID

tools.name: slam_discounts_summary
tools.description: [Requires slam_health] Returns discount code usage summary from order_discount_codes. Shows most-used codes, total discount amounts, and discount types.

tools.name: slam_discounts_active
tools.description: [Requires slam_health] Returns active discount codes from the discounts table (not order_discount_codes). Shows current live promotions.

tools.name: slam_fulfillment_tracking
tools.description: [Requires slam_health] Returns fulfillment records from the fulfillments table. Filter by order or status.

order_id.description: Filter to fulfillments for a specific order

tools.name: slam_refunds_summary
tools.description: [Requires slam_health] Returns refund records joined with refund line items. Shows refund amounts, reasons, and order context.

tools.name: slam_returns_summary
tools.description: [Requires slam_health] Returns return records from the returns table, joined with return line item counts.

tools.name: slam_draft_orders_list
tools.description: [Requires slam_health] Returns draft orders with line item counts. Draft orders are unpaid/pending orders not yet converted.

tools.name: slam_customers_list
tools.description: [Requires slam_health] Returns a paginated list of customers with orders_count and total_spent. Optionally filter by tag.

tag.description: Filter to customers that have this tag

tools.name: slam_customers_get
tools.description: [Requires slam_health] Returns a single customer by ID, including recent orders (up to 10) and metafields.

tools.name: slam_customers_by_tag
tools.description: [Requires slam_health] Returns customer tag distribution from the customer_tags table. Shows which tags are most common and how many customers have each.

tools.name: slam_customers_search
tools.description: [Requires slam_health] Search customers by email address or name fragment. Matches against email, first_name, and last_name using a case-insensitive substring search.

query.description: Search fragment matched against email, first_name, and last_name (case-insensitive LIKE)

tools.name: slam_customers_top
tools.description: [Requires slam_health] Returns customers ranked by total spend, order count, or average order value. Use min_orders to filter to repeat buyers only.

sort_by.description: Metric to rank by: total_spent, orders_count, or avg_order_value (default: total_spent)

sort_order.description: DESC = highest first (default), ASC = lowest first

min_orders.description: Only include customers with at least this many orders (repeat buyers filter)

tools.name: slam_customer_addresses
tools.description: [Requires slam_health] Returns customer addresses from the customer_addresses table.

customer_id.description: Filter to addresses for a specific customer

tools.name: slam_prices_current
tools.description: [Requires slam_health] Returns current variant prices. Use below_compare to show only variants where price < compare_at_price (on sale). Filterable by product_id.

below_compare.description: If true, only show variants where price < compare_at_price (on sale)

tools.name: slam_price_analysis
tools.description: [Requires slam_health] Returns variants with discount analysis from the price_comparison view. By default shows only items on sale (compare_at_price > price), sorted by biggest discount first.

on_sale_only.description: If true (default), only return variants where compare_at_price > price (items on sale)

min_discount_pct.description: Only return variants with discount_percentage >= this value (e.g. 20 for 20%+ off)

tools.name: slam_conditions_content
tools.description: [Requires slam_health] Runs content quality checks: products with empty descriptions, 'Copy of'/'Untitled' titles, or missing tags.

tools.name: slam_conditions_pricing
tools.description: [Requires slam_health] Runs pricing anomaly checks: zero-price variants, inverted compare_at_price, and compare_at_price equal to price.

tools.name: slam_conditions_identifiers
tools.description: [Requires slam_health] Runs identifier completeness checks: empty SKUs, empty barcodes, and duplicate product titles.

tools.name: slam_conditions_inventory
tools.description: [Requires slam_health] Runs inventory status checks: out-of-stock variants, negative inventory, and untracked inventory items.

tools.name: slam_conditions_orders
tools.description: [Requires slam_health] Runs order quality checks: orders with no line items, missing customer email, zero total price, and refunded-but-unfulfilled status.

tools.name: slam_conditions_customers
tools.description: [Requires slam_health] Runs customer quality checks: missing email, duplicate emails, zero order count, and customers with orders but zero total spent.

tools.name: slam_sales_summary
tools.description: [Requires slam_health] Returns a store sales dashboard: total orders, total revenue, average order value, breakdown by financial and fulfillment status, and top 5 products by revenue. Optionally filter by financial_status.

financial_status.description: Optional: filter to a single financial status (e.g. 'PAID', 'PENDING', 'REFUNDED')

tools.name: slam_sales_by_period
tools.description: [Requires slam_health] Returns orders grouped by day, week, or month — a time-series view of sales performance. Each period includes order_count, total revenue, and average order value. Most recent periods first.

limit.description: Number of periods to return, most recent first (default 12)

financial_status.description: Optional: filter to a single financial status (e.g. 'PAID', 'REFUNDED')

tools.name: slam_products_top
tools.description: [Requires slam_health] Returns products ranked by sales performance (revenue, units sold, or order count). Supports pagination, sort direction, and optional vendor/product_type filters. Uses the product_sales view which joins orders and line_items — only products with at least one order appear.

sort_by.description: Metric to sort by: total_revenue, units_sold, or order_count

sort_order.description: DESC = best sellers first (default), ASC = worst sellers first

product_type.description: Filter to a specific product type

tools.name: slam_products_bought_together
tools.description: [Requires slam_health] Returns product pairs ranked by co-purchase frequency — how often two products appear together in the same order. Use to discover bundle opportunities. Supply product_id to anchor on a specific product, or omit to see the top pairs across all orders.

product_id.description: Anchor product ID — find everything this product is bought with. Omit to see top pairs across all products.

min_co_orders.description: Minimum number of orders in which both products must appear together (default 2)

tools.name: slam_vendors_summary
tools.description: [Requires slam_health] Returns sales performance grouped by vendor — total revenue, units sold, order count, and product count per vendor. Sorted by revenue by default.

sort_by.description: Metric to sort by: total_revenue, units_sold, order_count, or product_count (default: total_revenue)

tools.name: slam_locations_list
tools.description: [Requires slam_health] Returns all fulfilment locations with stock totals. Uses the inventory_by_location view.

tools.name: slam_b2b_companies_list
tools.description: [Requires slam_health] Returns B2B companies with location and contact counts.

tools.name: slam_content_pages
tools.description: [Requires slam_health] Returns pages and articles for content audit. Use content_type filter to restrict to 'page' or 'article'.

tools.name: slam_gift_cards_summary
tools.description: [Requires slam_health] Returns outstanding gift card balance summary grouped by currency.

tools.name: slam_selling_plans_list
tools.description: [Requires slam_health] Returns subscription selling plan groups with plan and product counts.

tools.name: slam_store_snapshot
tools.description: [Requires slam_health] Returns a one-call store health snapshot: sales totals, inventory counts, data condition issue counts, and sync freshness. Answers 'what is the state of my store right now?' without requiring multiple tool calls.

tools.name: slam_run_query
tools.description: [Requires slam_health] Executes a read-only SQL query against the SLAM database with validation, pagination, money column warnings, and fuzzy error suggestions. Only SELECT, PRAGMA, EXPLAIN, and WITH statements are allowed.

sql.description: The SQL query to execute (SELECT/PRAGMA/EXPLAIN/WITH only)

params.description: Positional parameters for the query (use ? placeholders in SQL)

limit.description: Max rows to return if query has no LIMIT (1-100, default 25)

offset.description: Offset for pagination if query has no LIMIT
